message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.unruly.st: You strike out in your chains. The camp falls on you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.unruly.br: A captive tearing at the camp? They fall on you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.unruly.st: Caught rifling their stores. The camp falls on you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.unruly.pi: They see you working at the shackle. The camp falls on you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.unruly.sl: They heard you hammering at your chain. The camp falls on you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.unruly.sa: They catch you sawing at your rope. The camp falls on you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.chains.broke: A link gives way. The chain falls from your neck.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.chains.cut: The last strands part. The rope falls from your neck.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.113: Taken captive, your captors leave you be while you keep your place. Strike out, steal, break things or get caught at your bonds and the camp falls on you. A chain gives to a rock beaten on it, a rope to anything sharp, but both are heard or seen.
